calldata input array drives the reserve initialization loop
batchInitReserve invokes _initReserve for each input element
cachedPool local caches the pool state variable before the loop
_initReserve calls _initTokenWithProxy to deploy each token proxy
proxy.initialize performs a delegatecall executing caller supplied initParams
_initTokenWithProxy returns proxy addresses later upgraded through upgradeToAndCall
reserveData supplies the aToken proxy address used in updateAToken
updateAToken calls _upgradeTokenImplementation with proxy address and encoded call
updateStableDebtToken calls _upgradeTokenImplementation
updateVariableDebtToken calls _upgradeTokenImplementation
encodedCall is passed as initParams into _upgradeTokenImplementation
_upgradeTokenImplementation performs upgradeToAndCall, a delegatecall into an arbitrary implementation
the delegatecalled implementation executes arbitrary code and can re-enter the configurator
currentConfig is mutated with LTV, threshold and bonus then written via pool.setConfiguration
asset parameter selects the reserve configuration being modified
ltv parameter is validated and stored into the configuration map
liquidationThreshold parameter is validated and used in percentMul
liquidationBonus parameter is validated and used in the percentage multiplication
configureReserveAsCollateral calls _checkNoLiquidity when disabling collateral
deactivateReserve calls _checkNoLiquidity before deactivating
availableLiquidity is compared against zero in the no-liquidity requirement
configureReserveAsCollateral writes the updated config through pool.setConfiguration
_initReserve writes the reserve configuration through pool.setConfiguration
enableBorrowingOnReserve writes the updated config through pool.setConfiguration
disableBorrowingOnReserve writes the updated config through pool.setConfiguration

normalization_plan.reason: provider is only consumed to set the addressesProvider state var inside initialize
calldata input is only iterated inside batchInitReserve
asset parameter is only used to select the reserve configuration in that function
ltv parameter is only validated and stored inside the reserve configuration
liquidationThreshold is only used in the collateral configuration checks
liquidationBonus is only used in the collateral configuration checks
cachedPool is a local cache read only within batchInitReserve
currentConfig is a local configuration map manipulated by that function
reserveData is a local read of proxy addresses used during the token upgrade
encodedCall is a local buffer forwarded as initParams to the upgrade call
availableLiquidity is a local computed only in the no-liquidity check
